Recruitment Agency Sweden — Nigel Wright Talent Experts

Specialist recruitment agency in Sweden

Nigel Wright Group is a specialist multidiscipline recruitment agency in Stockholm, operating across Sweden and the Nordic region. We have several years of experience in helping businesses primarily active in consumer-facing sectors identify top talent for key roles. Clients and candidates value our combined sector and discipline expertise, wide networks, and high standards of customer service.

Multidiscipline talent recruitment in Sweden

Alongside fulfilling executive search projects focused hiring on CEOs, MDs, and other general leadership positions, we recruit various roles within the sales, marketing, supply chain, procurement, engineering, manufacturing, IT, HR, and finance functions. This includes delivering permanent and interim assignments, as well as assisting clients with talent mapping and employer branding services.

To discuss your hiring needs and find out more about our Sweden recruitment capabilities, please contact us directly or use the chat function below to talk with a member of our support team. Candidates can find all the latest jobs in Sweden on our vacancies job site. We also encourage applicants to enhance their job search by sending us their CVs and following us on social media.

Our track record as a recruitment company in Sweden

As a sector specialist recruitment agency in Sweden, we work with businesses of all sizes. Our client portfolio consists of start-ups, medium-sized companies, and multinational blue chips active in the Home & Personal care, Fashion & Lifestyle, Beauty & Cosmetics, Homeware, Food, Drinks, DIY, Consumer Electronics, Ecommerce & Retail, Travel & Leisure, and Toys & Children sectors including:

Clients praise our Sweden recruitment services:

“We used Nigel Wright Group to help us recruit Head of Marketing roles for Sweden & Denmark, and Norway. The consultant who led the searches knew the markets and took the time to really understand our needs. They fielded high-quality candidates, all worth second interviews, and demonstrated flexibility throughout. Extremely professional.” CMO, Burger King Scandinavia

“Thanks to Nigel Wright Group, Solera has hired various key sales, marketing, and supply chain people. I personally used them to recruit a Head of Supply Chain role. The target setting was sharp and the whole process was very structured. Communication and feedback were smooth too, and we happy to hire a suitable person with the right competencies.” Supply Chain Director, Solera Beverage Group

“Nigel Wright Group has recruited several key sales, marketing, e-commerce, finance, and HR roles for Wella in Sweden during the last few years. The search consultants I have personally dealt with have all been proactive and positive people, who work at speed to deliver the best results. Thanks to their help, we’ve hired some really good high-quality candidates.” Country Manager Sweden, Wella

Searching for recruitment companies in Sweden or recruiters in Stockholm?

If you require the services of a specialist talent recruiter in Stockholm or Sweden, please contact our marketing department via the email address below. A member of our team will respond on the same working day and direct your enquiry to one of our consultants.
